albalad.name: Al-Balad (Historic Jeddah)
albalad.price_text: Free to walk · guided tours often SAR 50–150
albalad.hours: Streets always open · shops roughly 10:00–22:00, closed during prayer
albalad.tip: Start at Bab Makkah gate and wander the coral-stone alleys early morning before the heat.

fountain.name: King Fahd's Fountain
fountain.price_text: Free to view from the Corniche
fountain.hours: Fountain runs in the evening; check on the day
fountain.tip: Best seen from the Corniche after dark — it is lit and shoots very high.

rahma.name: Al-Rahma Mosque (Floating Mosque)
rahma.hours: Open around prayer times; non-Muslims check access on the day
rahma.tip: Come near sunset for photos over the water; dress modestly and remove shoes.

shallal.name: Al-Shallal Theme Park
shallal.price_text: Ticket price varies by ride pass — check on the day
shallal.hours: Usually afternoon to late evening; confirm opening days
shallal.tip: Good for families with kids; check which rides are running before you buy.

corniche.name: Jeddah Corniche
corniche.price_text: Free · some beaches charge a small entry
corniche.tip: Walk or cycle the waterfront at sunset; it is cooler and busiest then.

sportscity.name: King Abdullah Sports City
sportscity.price_text: Match tickets vary — check on the day
sportscity.hours: Only on event or match days
sportscity.tip: Go only if there is a match or event; it is far north of the city.

moontoon.name: Moon Toon
moontoon.price_text: Entry price varies — check on the day
moontoon.hours: Usually afternoon to evening; confirm before going
moontoon.tip: Family entertainment spot; check current opening hours before you travel out.

souqalawi.name: Souq Al Alawi
souqalawi.price_text: Free to enter · bring cash for shopping
souqalawi.tip: Haggle gently and go in the morning for cooler, quieter lanes.

fishmarket.name: Jeddah Central Fish Market
fishmarket.price_text: Free to browse · buy by weight
fishmarket.hours: Early morning to midday; busiest at dawn
fishmarket.tip: Go early morning to see the catch and eat at nearby seafood spots.

cornicheview.name: Corniche sunset viewpoint
cornicheview.tip: Pick a spot facing west over the Red Sea about 30 minutes before sunset.

baladtour.name: Al-Balad walking tour
baladtour.price_text: ≈ SAR 50–150 per person — check on the day
baladtour.tip: A local guide explains the coral houses and hidden alleys; book ahead.

hamrawalk.name: Al-Hamra waterfront walk
hamrawalk.tip: A relaxed evening walk with cafes and sea views; good for families.

obhurdhow.name: Obhur dhow and boat trips
obhurdhow.price_text: ≈ SAR 100–250 per person — check on the day
obhurdhow.tip: Book a sunset boat trip for calm water and cooler air.

seafood.name: Seafood dinner on the Corniche
seafood.tip: Try grilled Red Sea fish; prices vary a lot, so check the menu first.

artwalk.name: Jeddah open-air art walk
artwalk.tip: The city has many public sculptures along the waterfront; walk and spot them at dusk.
